d: As a Sales Specialist, you will leverage your expertise to drive sales growth through strategic technology adoption. You will act as a bridge between the sales, commercial, and technology teams, ensuring the seamless integration of digital tools, automation, and data-driven solutions that enhance sales performance, customer engagement, and revenue generation. Your role will focus on identifying and implementing innovative technologies that optimize sales processes, improve efficiency, and support business expansion.
q: li
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or certifications in technology management or business transformation is a plus.
li
4+ years of experience in a technology advisory or consulting role, with a focus on commercial or business operations.
li
Strong knowledge of commercial technologies, including CRM systems, sales tools, marketing automation platforms, data analytics, and digital transformation tools.
li
Experience in assessing and implementing technology solutions to optimize commercial processes, such as sales pipelines, marketing strategies, and customer engagement.
li
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
li
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and offer creative technology solutions.
li
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of building relationships with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
li
Experience with cloud-based commercial technologies (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics).
li
Familiarity with data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., business intelligence, analytics platforms).
li
Experience in leading digital transformation projects within commercial organizations.
r: li
Drive technology-enabled sales growth by identifying and leveraging digital tools, platforms, and automation to enhance lead generation, customer engagement, and conversion rates.
li

Collaborate closely with commercial leadership and sales teams to identify technology solutions that streamline sales operations, improve customer relationship management (CRM), and support revenue generation.
li
Provide expert advice on emerging sales technologies, data-driven decision-making tools, and AI-driven solutions that align with commercial objectives and boost sales performance.
li
Assess existing sales and marketing technologies, recommending improvements or new tools to enhance efficiency, scalability, and competitiveness in customer acquisition and retention.
li
Lead the evaluation and implementation of sales enablement tools, automation platforms, and analytics solutions to optimize sales funnel performance.
li
Act as a subject matter expert in technology-driven sales strategies, providing guidance and best practices to cross-functional teams.
li
Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of industry trends, market conditions, and competitor technologies, advising on tech investments that enhance sales outcomes.
li
Support the digital transformation of sales processes, including CRM enhancements, data analytics, AI-powered lead scoring, and automation of key sales activities.
li
Provide regular sales technology updates and reports to senior leadership, ensuring teams stay informed about innovations that impact sales effectiveness and market positioning.
li
Manage end-to-end deal processes, ensuring effective coordination from lead identification through to deal closure.
li
Create and prepare high-quality proposals and tenders, aligning with client needs, commercial strategies, and compliance requirements.

d: This role exists to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of Operation team ad-hoc tasks and CS\ITSM ticketing system, a critical tool for customer support and internal flow automation. The support Operations Coordinator plays a vital role in maximizing the system's effectiveness by managing our outsourced support team, facilitating clear communication between internal Zain staff and the support team, and proactively identifying opportunities for system improvement. This ultimately contributes to Improved customer satisfaction, streamline internal processes and increased efficiency.
Requirements & Analysis: Gather requirements, analyze feedback, collaborate on prioritization, and conduct UAT. Deliverable: System improvements aligned with user needs.
Vendor Management: Audit vendor performance and negotiate service levels.
Communication: Communicate system status such as incidents and changes, collaborate with teams, and facilitate meetings.
Other Tasks: Perform any other duties related to the ticketing system, support operations, or departmental needs.
BS in Computer Information System, Software Engineering, Computer Science or any related major.
0-1 years of experience is a plus.
